source_adjudication.case: R-013 Chicago drywall repair after leak, no structural/no electrical/no plumbing, $3,500
source_adjudication.official_excerpt: A building permit is not required for removing and replacing up to 1,000 square feet of drywall or plaster, without alteration of any mechanical, electrical, or plumbing device or system.
source_adjudication.rationale: The requested scope is one bedroom drywall replacement after leak with explicit no structural, no electrical, no plumbing, and job value $3,500; it fits Chicago DOB no-permit drywall/plaster exemption boundaries.
